name: Eraser-1st Phase Clinical Trial
source:
It's Summer 20xx. I was given an assignment for my "final project" to watch over Violanda Margaritifera, an ordinary 16-years old high school girl, who was participated on the clinical trials of some kind of new substance on development. It is said that the substance has an effect on erasing some specific parts of someone's memories...Instead of having a standard procedures which require her to stay on the isolated facility during the treatment, she was given a freedom to lead a normal everyday life and attend school like she usually did. As the consequences, I have to watch her on her school and disguise my appearance as high-school student too. However, that girl is more troublesome than she looks...and many things is not going smoothly as I planned...

[From [url=http://project-eraser.weebly.com/story.html]The Official site[/url]]
translation:
20xx年夏。我的“毕业设计”任务是监视维奥兰达·玛格丽蒂费拉。她是一名普通的16岁女高中生，参加了某种新开发物质的临床试验。据说这种物质能够抹去某些特定的记忆……通常的流程要求她在治疗期间留在隔离设施中，但她获准过正常的日常生活，像往常一样上学。因此，我必须在学校里监视她，还要伪装成高中生。不过，这个女孩比看上去麻烦得多……许多事情都没有按我的计划顺利进行……

[译自[url=http://project-eraser.weebly.com/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
